accessibility: Each facet pairs its status icon with a sentence, and freshness is a text badge (Fresh, Stale, Unknown) with an icon, never color alone.
The access notice names the missing permission key in words next to an icon.
constraints: Built only from Adapter Widgets (Stack, Text, Icon, Badge, Button, Disclosure, Image); the tiles show a sample Asset in place of a screenshot, and the facet icons and the freshness badges are shown by a Variant.

The facet sentences with two or three counts (the Evidence summary, the resolved counts) are baked samples under readiness.sample.*; the contexts, the Widget id, the code names and the counts are sample content.
Tooltips, the viewer Modal opened by a tile (its own View), the Checks navigation to a Widget and the deferred-selection notice are not modelled.
Every visible string is bound with $i18n except identities (render contexts, Widget ids, diagnostic codes); en-US and zh-TW keep identical key sets.
Visual language follows the Quiet Canvas design system in DESIGN.md.
entryConditions: A member selected the Readiness tab of the right panel of a View in the Workbench; the panel is 340px wide at the right edge and scrolls.

The base state is the View Checkout for a holder of evidence.capture and handoff.export on a desktop layout: one Checks finding, six formal captures (three fresh, two stale, one unknown), two Reviews waiting and one open, and a Handoff blocked by an open Review and stale Evidence.
The render context selects one Workspace viewport preset, one Locale and one theme; below 1280px capture is offered on desktop only, and below 640px Export handoff is not offered.
spec.intent: Show the Readiness panel of a View as built from Adapter Widgets only: four facets (Validation, Evidence, Reviews, Handoff) each with a status icon, a plain sentence and one action, then what needs a fresh capture and the contact sheet of the View's formal captures.
interactionRules: Handoff is the readiness gate run with this View as the only root: it reads "implementation-ready" only when the closure has a fresh complete formal capture of the View, no open or ready-for-review Review thread (the Workspace threads included) and no blocking diagnostic; otherwise it says "Not implementation-ready" and lists each blocking issue as one sentence naming the View, and each won't-fix Review as a non-blocking advisory note.

Evidence counts the View's formal captures as fresh, stale or unknown; a capture whose View, Locale, Adapters or Product Kit changed since it was taken is stale and says why, one whose provenance cannot be judged is unknown and counts as not fresh.

Captures that need a fresh run are listed first, three at a time with Show all, and Capture these again opens the capture list for exactly those contexts; the contact sheet shows one tile per capture with its render context and freshness.
Validation lists the View's Checks findings with the Widget each names; Reviews counts the threads anchored here; Recheck reads Evidence and the assessment again.
A member without evidence.capture or handoff.export is told which key is missing and the action is not offered; the server stays the authority.
